text: Being here, I feel a sense of anticipation and reflection. The empty, glass-walled meeting room suggests preparation or aftermath—a quiet moment before or after communal engagement. The adjacent exhibition wall, vibrant and filled with innovation, engages my curiosity and makes me ponder human creativity and the endless drive to understand and construct meaning. This juxtaposition of spaces makes me aware of the dual nature of public and private thought, of dialogue and introspection.
